title: Kite Flyer — Wind Physics Sandbox
description: Fly a kite on a taut line through a semicircular wind window — steer, reel, and chase gusts and thermals without crashing.
concept: A kite-flying arcade physics toy built on a 'flying window' model: the kite arcs across a semicircle above the pilot, pulled taut by wind power that peaks overhead and fades at the edges. Drag or use arrow keys to steer left/right and reel the line in/out, pick from 3 kites with different handling, tune wind strength, gusts and thermals, then pull off a slack-pop stunt dive. Best flight times persist per kite type, and you can snapshot the sky or copy a share link that reproduces your exact wind conditions.
features: 3 kite types (Diamond, Delta, Box) with distinct lift, drag, weight and turn-rate stats
Combined drag/arrow-key control: horizontal = steer, vertical = reel line in/out
Wind strength slider plus gust and thermal toggles that perturb the flight window in real time
Slack Pop stunt trick that momentarily lengthens the line for a dive-and-swoop
Best-flight-time leaderboard per kite type saved to localStorage
PNG snapshot export and a shareable URL hash that reproduces kite type + wind seed + settings
tech: Web Audio API (procedural wind hum + crash/pop SFX)

interaction.mouse: Drag on the sky to steer left/right and reel the line in/out; click UI buttons to switch kites, toggle wind modes, snapshot or share
interaction.click: Tap a kite type to switch, tap Slack Pop for a stunt dive, tap icons to mute, snapshot or copy a share link
interaction.touch: Same as mouse via touch drag; all controls sized for thumb reach in the bottom glass panel
interaction.keyboard: Arrow Left/Right to steer, Arrow Up/Down to reel, Space to trigger Slack Pop
